name: electrical-engineering
description: Electrical Engineering: circuit fundamentals, real component behaviour and parasitics, DC analysis, AC impedance and filters, semiconductors (diodes, BJTs, MOSFETs, thermal), op-amps, digital logic and interfacing, power and regulators, signal integrity and grounding, EMC and EMI, PCB design, test equipment and how not to lie to yourself with a scope, datasheets and part selection, electrical safety, and hardware debugging.
